items.title_cn: 入院时C反应蛋白、血清白蛋白、C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值及BISAP评分对急性胰腺炎严重程度早期预测的诊断性能比较：一项前瞻性观察性研究
items.title_en: Comparative Diagnostic Performance of Admission C-Reactive Protein, Serum Albumin, the C-Reactive Protein-to-Albumin Ratio, and the BISAP Score for Early Prediction of Acute Pancreatitis Severity: A Prospective Observational Study
items.summary_cn: 该研究为前瞻性观察性研究，比较入院时C反应蛋白、血清白蛋白、C反应蛋白与白蛋白比值及BISAP评分对急性胰腺炎严重程度早期预测的诊断性能；摘要未提供具体结果数据。

items.title_cn: 高甘油三酯血症诱发的坏死性胰腺炎继发感染性胰腺包裹性坏死：一例病例报告
items.title_en: Infected Pancreatic Walled-off Necrosis Following Hypertriglyceridemia-Induced Necrotizing Pancreatitis: A Case Report
items.abstract_cn: 感染性包裹性坏死（WON）是坏死性胰腺炎的严重并发症，需要及时、循证的管理。我们描述一例41岁男性患者，有严重高甘油三酯血症相关坏死性胰腺炎病史，表现为包裹性胰腺/胰周积液，病灶内含有气体，符合感染性WON。增强计算机断层扫描显示无新发胰腺实质坏死证据，现有检查结果未能确立急性坏死性胰腺炎复发。患者接受了超声内镜引导下透壁引流，随后作为升阶梯治疗策略的一部分接受了两次内镜下坏死组织清除术，并联合抗菌药物治疗。从坏死积液获取的培养物鉴定出少见微生物，包括黏液罗氏菌、莫氏索罗菌和厌氧消化链球菌。在一次内镜操作过程中，患者出现窄QRS波心动过速伴一过性低血压。随后心电图评估显示心室预激，符合Wolff-Parkinson-White综合征，但急性心律失常的机制无法确切确立。经多学科管理后，患者住院期间临床改善良好并出院。本病例突出了微创升阶梯管理在适当选择患者中的作用、在临床背景下解读异常微生物学发现的重要性，以及识别可能影响操作安全的心血管状况的必要性。需要进一步研究以阐明从感染性WON中分离出的少见微生物的临床意义。
items.abstract_en: Infected walled-off necrosis (WON) is a serious complication of necrotizing pancreatitis that requires timely, evidence-based management.We describe the case of a 41-year-old man with a history of severe hypertriglyceridemia-associated necrotizing pancreatitis who presented with an encapsulated pancreatic/peripancreatic collection containing intralesional gas, consistent with infected WON.Contrastenhanced computed tomography showed no evidence of new pancreatic parenchymal necrosis, and the available findings did not establish a recurrent episode of acute necrotizing pancreatitis.The patient underwent endoscopic ultrasound-guided transmural drainage followed by two endoscopic necrosectomies as part of a step-up approach, combined with antimicrobial therapy.Cultures obtained from the necrotic collection identified uncommon microorganisms, including Rothia mucilaginosa, Solobacterium moorei, and Peptostreptococcus anaerobius.During an endoscopic procedure, the patient developed narrow-complex tachycardia with transient hypotension.Subsequent electrocardiographic evaluation revealed ventricular pre-excitation consistent with Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome, although the mechanism of the acute arrhythmia could not be definitively established.Following multidisciplinary management, the patient demonstrated favorable clinical improvement during hospitalization and was discharged.This case highlights the role of minimally invasive step-up management in appropriately selected patients, the importance of interpreting unusual microbiological findings in their clinical context, and the need to recognize cardiovascular conditions that may influence procedural safety.Further investigation is warranted to clarify the clinical significance of uncommon microorganisms isolated from infected WON.
items.summary_cn: 本文报道一例高甘油三酯血症相关坏死性胰腺炎后感染性包裹性坏死（WON）患者，采用EUS引导下透壁引流联合两次内镜下坏死清除术的阶梯治疗方案并联合抗菌治疗，坏死物培养检出少见微生物；术中出现窄QRS波心动过速伴一过性低血压，后续心电图提示WPW综合征。

items.title_cn: 支持所提交稿件的源数据：布拉氏酵母菌衍生肌苷通过A2AR-CREB轴减轻急性胰腺炎
items.title_en: Source data supporting the submitted manuscript: Saccharomyces boulardii-derived inosine attenuates acute pancreatitis through the A2AR-CREB axis
items.abstract_cn: 本数据集包含支持手稿《布拉氏酵母菌来源的肌苷通过A2AR-CREB轴减轻急性胰腺炎》的数值源数据和显微镜图像导出文件。该研究探讨了布拉氏酵母菌和肌苷在实验性急性胰腺炎中的作用，并包含补充性临床细胞因子检测。该记录由九个独立的ZIP压缩包组成。Supplementary_Data_1_Numerical_Data.zip包含74个数据CSV文件、一个重现较小数值表格的Excel工作簿，以及一个Contents.csv索引和README.txt。这些文件包括计算得出的检测浓度、组织学评分、荧光定量、相对基因表达测量值、经处理的RNA-seq分析结果以及培养上清液代谢组学差异分析结果。临床细胞因子文件对应手稿的图8A（IL-6）、图8B（IL-8）和图8D（TNF-alpha）；它们包含编码的参与者标识符、治疗分组以及基线/治疗后测量列。Supplementary Data 2-5均以Part1和Part2 ZIP文件形式提供。这八个图像压缩包共包含86个TIFF显微镜导出文件。每个ZIP可独立打开，并包含各自的Contents.csv和README.txt。这些索引提供了精确的图面板、检测项目和实验分组映射关系；补充数据压缩包编号与手稿图号并非一一对应。图像文件名和元数据标签已标准化为英文，来源和处理细节记录于README文件中。记录元数据和DOI是公开的。文件访问仅限于保密的编辑和同行评审评估。访问和再利用受附于该记录的权利声明管辖。手稿确定匡茂斌、郑攀、李乐妍和魏冠月为共同第一作者，朱银和何聪为通讯作者。
items.abstract_en: This collection contains numerical source data and microscopy image exports supporting the manuscript "Saccharomyces boulardii-derived inosine attenuates acute pancreatitis through the A2AR-CREB axis". The study investigates Saccharomyces boulardii and inosine in experimental acute pancreatitis and includes complementary clinical cytokine measurements. The record comprises nine independent ZIP archives. Supplementary_Data_1_Numerical_Data.zip contains 74 data CSV files, an Excel workbook reproducing the smaller numerical tables, and a Contents.csv index and README.txt. These files include calculated assay concentrations, histology scores, fluorescence quantification, relative gene-expression measurements, processed RNA-seq analysis results, and culture-supernatant metabolomics differential-analysis results. The clinical cytokine files correspond to Figure 8A (IL-6), Figure 8B (IL-8), and Figure 8D (TNF-alpha) of the manuscript; they contain coded participant identifiers, treatment groups, and baseline/post-treatment measurement columns. Supplementary Data 2-5 are each supplied as Part1 and Part2 ZIP files. These eight image archives contain 86 TIFF microscopy exports in total. Each ZIP can be opened independently and includes its own Contents.csv and README.txt. These indexes provide the exact figure-panel, assay, and experimental-group mappings; the supplementary-data archive numbers do not correspond one-to-one to manuscript figure numbers. Image filenames and metadata labels were standardized to English, with provenance and processing details documented in the README files. The record metadata and DOI are public. File access is restricted to confidential editorial and peer-review assessment. Access and reuse are governed by the rights statement attached to the record. The manuscript identifies Maobin Kuang, Pan Zheng, Leyan Li, and Guanyue Wei as joint first authors, and Yin Zhu and Cong He as corresponding authors.
items.journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
items.summary_cn: 该研究探讨了布拉氏酵母菌及其衍生的肌苷在实验性急性胰腺炎中的作用，并发现其通过A2AR-CREB轴减轻急性胰腺炎，同时包含临床细胞因子（IL-6、IL-8、TNF-alpha）的补充测量数据。

items.title_cn: 细胞因子网络分析与基于机器学习的急性胰腺炎疾病严重程度分层
items.title_en: Cytokine network analysis and machine learning-based stratification of disease severity in acute pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种以局部胰腺炎症和复杂免疫失调为特征的急腹症。鉴于炎症细胞因子在AP病理生理学中的核心作用及其与疾病严重程度的潜在关联，我们比较了轻度、中度和重度AP患者之间的血浆细胞因子谱。进一步采用相关网络分析表征细胞因子之间的相关模式，并应用机器学习方法进行探索性严重程度分层。在本研究中，我们回顾性纳入了220例急性胰腺炎患者（轻度、中度或重度），并获取了八种细胞因子（IL-2、IL-4、IL-6、IL-10、IL-12p70、IL-17、IFN-γ和TNF-α）的血浆细胞因子测量数据。进行相关网络分析以表征与严重程度相关的细胞因子相关模式。应用了两种探索性机器学习方法，包括基于LASSO的多项逻辑回归用于细胞因子特征选择，以及随机森林分析用于重度与非重度AP的分层。模型性能通过重复嵌套交叉验证、基于ROC的判别指标和变量重要性分析进行评估。细胞因子网络分析显示，不同AP严重程度组之间的相关模式仅存在描述性差异；然而，经错误发现率（FDR）校正后，任何单个细胞因子-细胞因子相关性在组间均未保持统计学显著性。细胞因子分布在各组之间存在部分重叠，表明使用单一生物标志物的可分离性有限。LASSO回归识别出与严重程度相关的细胞因子子集，而随机森林建模在重复嵌套交叉验证后对重度疾病分类表现出中等判别能力，具有高特异性但敏感性有限。不同分析方法之间的特征选择结果存在差异，但IL-6和IL-10 consistently被突出为具有信息量的细胞因子。这些发现表明，基于细胞因子的探索性建模可能为AP严重程度分层提供补充信息。本研究为研究基于细胞因子的严重程度分层提供了初步框架，并支持未来在更大规模前瞻性队列中进行验证研究。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an acute abdominal disease characterized by local pancreatic inflammation and complex immune dysregulation. Given the central role of inflammatory cytokines in AP pathophysiology and their potential association with disease severity, we compared plasma cytokine profiles among patients with mild, moderately severe, and severe AP. Correlation patterns among cytokines were further characterized using correlation network analysis, and machine learning approaches were applied for exploratory severity stratification. In this study, we retrospectively included 220 patients with acute pancreatitis (mild, moderately severe, or severe) and retrieved plasma cytokine measurements of eight cytokines (IL-2, IL-4, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12p70, IL-17, IFN-γ, and TNF-α). Correlation network analysis was performed to characterize severity-associated cytokine correlation patterns. Two exploratory machine learning approaches were applied, including LASSO-based multinomial logistic regression for cytokine feature selection and random forest analysis for severe versus non-severe AP stratification. Model performance was evaluated using repeated nested cross-validation, ROC-based discrimination metrics, and variable importance analysis. Cytokine network analysis showed only descriptive differences in correlation patterns across AP severity groups; however, no between-group difference in any individual cytokine–cytokine correlation remained statistically significant after false discovery rate (FDR) correction. Cytokine distributions showed partial overlap across groups, indicating limited separability using single biomarkers. LASSO regression identified a subset of cytokines associated with severity, while random forest modeling demonstrated moderate discriminative ability for severe disease classification after repeated nested cross-validation, with high specificity but limited sensitivity. Feature selection results differed between analytical approaches, but IL-6 and IL-10 were consistently highlighted as informative cytokines. These findings suggest that cytokine-based exploratory modeling may provide complementary information for AP severity stratification. This study provides a preliminary framework for investigating cytokine-based severity stratification and supports future validation studies in larger prospective cohorts.
items.summary_cn: 该研究比较了轻、中重、重度急性胰腺炎患者的血浆细胞因子谱，相关性网络分析在FDR校正后未发现组间细胞因子相关模式有统计学显著差异；LASSO和随机森林建模对重症AP分层仅显示中等区分能力（高特异性、低敏感性），IL-6和IL-10被一致识别为信息性细胞因子。

items.title_cn: 治疗性血浆置换在高甘油三酯性急性胰腺炎及肝脏疾病中的应用
items.title_en: Utilization of therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) for hypertriglyceridemic acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) and liver disorders
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题涉及治疗性血浆置换（TPE）在高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）及肝脏疾病中的应用，属于急性胰腺炎诊治范畴，与研究方向核心关注点（1）急性胰腺炎诊治相关；但摘要缺失，无法获取具体研究结果与发现。

items.title_cn: 中性粒细胞百分比与白蛋白比值预测ICU急性胰腺炎患者28天死亡率：一项结合机器学习的回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: The neutrophil percentage-to-albumin ratio predicts 28-day mortality in ICU patients with acute pancreatitis: a retrospective cohort study with machine learning analysis
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 背景 中性粒细胞百分比与白蛋白比值（NPAR）近年来被认为是危重症患者疾病严重程度的标志物，但其在急性胰腺炎（AP）中的应用价值尚未充分确立。鉴于重症AP相关的高死亡率，早期风险分层至关重要。本研究旨在探讨ICU中急性胰腺炎（AP）患者NPAR与28天全因死亡率之间的关联。方法 本回顾性队列研究从MIMIC-IV数据库中提取数据。主要终点为28天全因死亡率。采用多变量Cox回归、限制性立方样条（RCS）分析和Kaplan-Meier生存分析评估NPAR与死亡率之间的关联。通过受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估其预测性能，并与各单独组分及SOFA评分进行比较。进一步构建机器学习模型以验证其重要性。结果 在532例符合条件的患者中，73例（13.7%）在28天内死亡。非存活者的NPAR水平显著更高（P < 0.001）。RCS分析显示NPAR与死亡风险呈正线性关联（总体P < 0.001）。在调整混杂因素（年龄、性别、SOFA评分、合并症）后，NPAR升高仍为死亡的独立预测因子（HR 1.031，95% CI 1.005–1.058，P = 0.021）。NPAR对死亡预测的AUC为0.71（95% CI 0.63–0.78），优于中性粒细胞百分比（0.60）或单独白蛋白（0.67），但略低于SOFA评分（0.75）。NPAR > 28.81的患者生存率显著更差（log-rank P < 0.001）。亚组分析证实了其一致的预测价值。在机器学习模型中，NPAR被识别为关键预测特征。结论 NPAR升高与危重症AP患者28天全因死亡率增加独立相关。它可作为补充性预后信号，有助于识别需要更密切监测的高危患者。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Background The neutrophil percentage-to-albumin ratio (NPAR) has recently been recognized as a marker of disease severity in critically ill patients. Its utility in acute pancreatitis (AP) is not well established. Given the high mortality associated with severe AP, early risk stratification is crucial. This study aimed to examine the association between NPAR and 28-day all-cause mortality in patients with acute pancreatitis (AP) in the ICU. Methods This retrospective cohort study extracted data from the MIMIC-IV database. The primary endpoint was 28-day all-cause mortality. The association between NPAR and mortality was evaluated using multivariable Cox regression, restricted cubic spline (RCS) analysis, and Kaplan-Meier survival analysis. Its predictive performance was assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and compared with individual components and the SOFA score. Machine learning models were further constructed to validate its importance. Results Among 532 eligible patients, 73 (13.7%) died within 28 days. Non-survivors had significantly higher NPAR levels ( P < 0.001). RCS analysis showed a positive linear association between NPAR and mortality risk (P for overall < 0.001). After adjusting for confounders (age, sex, SOFA score, comorbidities), elevated NPAR remained an independent predictor of mortality (HR 1.031, 95% CI 1.005–1.058, P = 0.021). NPAR demonstrated an AUC of 0.71 (95% CI 0.63–0.78) for mortality prediction, superior to neutrophil percentage (0.60) or albumin alone (0.67), though slightly lower than the SOFA score (0.75). Patients with NPAR > 28.81 had significantly worse survival (log-rank P < 0.001). Subgroup analyses confirmed its consistent predictive value. In machine learning models, NPAR was identified as a key predictive feature. Conclusion Elevated NPAR was independently associated with increased 28-day all-cause mortality in critically ill patients with AP. It may serve as a complementary prognostic signal that helps identify high-risk patients who warrant closer monitoring.
items.summary_cn: 在532例ICU急性胰腺炎患者中，NPAR升高与28天全因死亡率独立相关（HR 1.031，95% CI 1.005–1.058），其预测AUC为0.71，优于中性粒细胞百分比或白蛋白单项但略低于SOFA评分；NPAR>28.81者生存显著更差，机器学习模型亦将其识别为关键预测特征。

items.title_cn: 可解释机器学习模型预测重症急性胰腺炎患者30天内主要不良肾脏事件：多中心队列的开发与验证
items.title_en: Interpretable machine learning model for predicting major adverse kidney events within 30 days in critically ill patients with acute pancreatitis: development and validation in multicenter cohorts
items.abstract_cn: 背景 急性肾损伤是急性胰腺炎（AP）常见且严重的并发症，可导致死亡率升高和医疗负担加重。30天内主要不良肾脏事件（MAKE30）是评估肾脏结局的以患者为中心的复合终点。然而，缺乏有效工具来识别MAKE30高风险患者。本研究旨在开发并外部验证一个可解释的机器学习模型，用于预测重症AP患者的MAKE30。方法 使用三个临床数据集。MIMIC-IV作为开发队列，外部验证使用eICU-CRD和西南医科大学附属医院（AHSWMU）的回顾性队列。特征选择结合了最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）回归、Boruta算法和多变量逻辑回归。使用七种机器学习算法开发预测模型。从区分度、校准度和临床实用性方面评估模型性能。使用Shapley加法解释（SHAP）对最终模型进行解释和可视化。结果 共纳入来自多个中心的1，574例AP患者。选择六个预测因子用于模型开发：血清肌酐、红细胞分布宽度、白蛋白、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、血管升压药使用和总胆红素。随机森林模型表现出良好的整体性能，内部验证队列中受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.863。在两个独立外部验证队列中性能一致，eICU-CRD中AUC为0.840，AHSWMU中AUC为0.848。开发了基于网络的临床风险计算器，以促进模型在临床实践中的应用。结论 本研究开发的模型在预测重症AP患者MAKE30方面表现出良好的性能和稳健的泛化能力，为早期风险分层和个体化干预策略提供了可靠的数字化决策支持。
items.abstract_en: Background Acute kidney injury is a frequent and serious complication of acute pancreatitis (AP), contributing to increased mortality and healthcare burden. Major adverse kidney events within 30 days (MAKE30) constitute a patient-centered composite endpoint for assessing kidney outcomes. However, effective tools for identifying patients at high risk of MAKE30 are lacking. This study aimed to develop and externally validate an interpretable machine learning model for predicting MAKE30 in critically ill patients with AP. Methods Three clinical datasets were used. MIMIC-IV served as the development cohort, and external validation used eICU-CRD and a retrospective cohort from the Affiliated Hospital of Southwest Medical University (AHSWMU). Feature selection combined least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression, the Boruta algorithm, and multivariable logistic regression. Seven machine learning algorithms were used to develop prediction models. Model performance was assessed in terms of discrimination, calibration, and clinical utility. Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) were used to interpret and visualize the final model. Results A total of 1,574 patients with AP from multiple centers were included. Six predictors were selected for model development: serum creatinine, red cell distribution width, albumin, aspartate aminotransferase, vasopressor use, and total bilirubin. The random forest model demonstrated favorable overall performance, with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.863 in the internal validation cohort. Performance was consistent across the two independent external validation cohorts, with AUCs of 0.840 in eICU-CRD and 0.848 in AHSWMU. A web-based clinical risk calculator was developed to facilitate model use in clinical practice. Conclusion The model developed in this study exhibited favorable performance and robust generalizability in predicting MAKE30 among critically ill patients with AP, providing reliable digital decision support for early risk stratification and individualized intervention strategies.
items.summary_cn: 该研究基于MIMIC-IV开发并外部验证（eICU-CRD及西南医科大学附属医院队列）了一个可解释机器学习模型，用于预测重症急性胰腺炎患者30天内主要不良肾脏事件（MAKE30），最终随机森林模型纳入血清肌酐、红细胞分布宽度、白蛋白、AST、升压药使用和总胆红素6个预测因子，内部验证AUC为0.863，两个外部验证队列AUC分别为0.840和0.848，并开发了网页版临床风险计算器。

items.title_cn: 合并胆囊结石与内镜下乳头切除术后期胆道不良事件的关联
items.title_en: Association Between Concomitant Gallstones and Late Biliary Adverse Events After Endoscopic Papillectomy
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 背景/目的：内镜下乳头切除术（EP）后的晚期不良事件（AEs）特征尚不明确。我们研究了合并胆囊结石（GS）与EP后晚期AEs之间的关联。方法：我们回顾性分析了2004年至2025年间因壶腹部肿瘤接受EP的患者。晚期AEs定义为EP后≥30天发生的、需要医疗干预的症状性胰胆事件。分析纳入胆囊完整的患者。主要结局为至首次晚期AE的时间；次要分析使用年龄和性别调整的Cox模型评估其胆道或胰腺表型。结果：313例患者中，292例胆囊完整，包括54例合并GS和238例无GS。晚期AEs发生率分别为25.9%和10.5%。GS与首次晚期AE相关（调整风险比[aHR]，2.97；95%置信区间[CI]，1.53–5.75）及其胆道表型相关（aHR，3.58；95% CI：1.71–7.49），但与其胰腺表型无关。首次晚期AE的1年累积发生率为23.2%对5.7%（log-rank，p < 0.001）。在总体43例发生晚期AEs的患者中，35例（81.4%）接受了内镜逆行胰胆管造影术，9例（20.9%）出现复发。结论：合并GS与EP后晚期AEs相关，可能是晚期胆道事件的风险标志物。
items.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Background/Purpose Late adverse events (AEs) following endoscopic papillectomy (EP) are poorly characterized. We examined the association between concomitant gallstones (GS) and late AEs after EP. Methods We retrospectively analyzed patients undergoing EP for ampullary tumors between 2004 and 2025. Late AEs were symptomatic pancreatobiliary events occurring ≥ 30 days after EP and requiring medical intervention. Analyses included patients with intact gallbladders. The primary outcome was time to the first late AE; secondary analyses evaluated its biliary or pancreatic phenotype using age‐ and sex‐adjusted Cox models. Results Of 313 patients, 292 had intact gallbladders, including 54 with GS and 238 without GS. Late AEs occurred in 25.9% and 10.5%, respectively. GS was associated with the first late AE (adjusted hazard ratio [aHR], 2.97; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.53–5.75) and its biliary phenotype (aHR, 3.58; 95% CI: 1.71–7.49) but not its pancreatic phenotype. One‐year cumulative incidence of the first late AE was 23.2% versus 5.7% (log‐rank, p < 0.001). Among the 43 patients with late AEs overall, 35 (81.4%) underwent endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography, and nine (20.9%) experienced recurrence. Conclusions Concomitant GS was associated with late AEs after EP and may be a risk marker for late biliary events.
items.summary_cn: 在313例因壶腹部肿瘤行内镜乳头切除术的患者中，合并胆囊结石与术后晚期胆胰不良事件（尤其是胆道表型事件）风险显著升高相关（aHR 2.97，胆道表型aHR 3.58），1年累积发生率23.2% vs 5.7%，提示胆囊结石可能是晚期胆道事件的风险标志。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
